Settings

Display
Red Hat Text OFL · headline and prose
Text
Red Hat Text OFL
Mono
Red Hat Mono OFL · commands, flags, output
Moves
mono-led, tight setting
Mood
fast, exact, dry, confident
Case
Sentence case everywhere; commands keep their real case; never all-caps prose.
Numerals and features
font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-feature-settings: "zero" 1

0.80 s · 1040 ms · 0x0F0.80 s · 1040 ms · 0x0F

Timings align in columns; the dotted or slashed zero avoids 0/O mistakes.
Signature
A superfamily pair (sans and mono drawn together) set tight: headline at -0.025 em, output at 13 to 14 px, and the only colour is the prompt mark and the one live state.
Use when
CLIs, developer platforms, build and deploy tools, API docs.
Turns into slop when
When it dresses as a fake terminal window (dots, title bar), when every line glows, or when code samples are invented outputs posing as real benchmarks.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
Specimen copy is placeholder text written for this library; it describes no real product or result.
